title: Relief on a Car Rental Release Charge for a Membership of Standing
content:
A traveller club membership held with the Wanderlane Traveller Club relieves the release charge on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes, according to the tier the membership stands at and how long it has been held.

**The relief schedule.**

| The membership standing in the renter's name | Relieved at |
|---|---|
| Active at Wanderlane Gold, Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium or Wanderlane Ambassador, held for at least 2 years | 15 percent |
| Active at Wanderlane Blue or Wanderlane Silver, held for at least 2 years | 5 percent |
| Held for less than 2 years, or none at all | Nothing |

The relief is taken off the amount the release charge stands at when this relief is applied. The term of holding is counted from the date the membership was enrolled to the handling date, in years of 365 days.

**The two parts of each condition.** Both of the first two entitlements require an active membership at a named tier and a term of at least 2 years together. A membership at Wanderlane Ambassador enrolled 18 months ago relieves nothing, the term being short; a membership at Wanderlane Blue enrolled 4 years ago relieves 5 percent; a membership at Wanderlane Gold enrolled 4 years ago relieves 15 percent. A membership that is not active relieves nothing whatever its tier or its age.

**The boundary on the term.** At exactly 2 years of holding the relief stands, the entitlement turning on a term of at least that length; a day short of 2 years it does not.
